2123828255425790113.en_summary: (Reposted by @tastyliveshow) Today so far is aligning with one of the patterns we found in 15 years of intraday $SPX data, but the test is far from over. Going back to 2012, the median day had made about 47% of SPX’s high-low range by 09:35 CT, in only 16% of the session. As of 11:05 CT, 47% of today’s range so far was set in the first hour, with SPX down about 2.1%. The afternoon will tell us whether today ends in line with history or not.
2123828255425790113.zh_summary: （由@tastyliveshow轉推）今天到目前為止與我們在15年的盤中$SPX數據中發現的模式之一相符，但測試遠未結束。回到2012年，中位數的日子在09:35 CT時已完成SPX高低範圍的約47%，僅佔交易時段的16%。截至11:05 CT，今天迄今範圍的47%是在第一小時設定的，SPX下跌約2.1%。下午將告訴我們今天是否與歷史一致。
